properties.displayName: Azure Firewall Policy should enable Threat Intelligence
properties.description: Threat intelligence-based filtering can be enabled for your firewall to alert and deny traffic from/to known malicious IP addresses and domains. The IP addresses and domains are sourced from the Microsoft Threat Intelligence feed.

metadata.description: Start in audit mode. Only effects supported by the source definition are available.

properties.displayName: Web Application Firewall (WAF) should be enabled for Application Gateway
properties.description: Deploy Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) in front of public facing web applications for additional inspection of incoming traffic. Web Application Firewall (WAF) provides centralized protection of your web applications from common exploits and vulnerabilities such as SQL injections, Cross-Site Scripting, local and remote file executions. You can also restrict access to your web applications by countries, IP address ranges, and other http(s) parameters via custom rules.

properties.description: Network Watcher is a regional service that enables you to monitor and diagnose conditions at a network scenario level in, to, and from Azure. Scenario level monitoring enables you to diagnose problems at an end to end network level view. It is required to have a network watcher resource group to be created in every region where a virtual network is present. An alert is enabled if a network watcher resource group is not available in a particular region.

properties.displayName: Selected hub Firewall Policies must explicitly enable DNS proxy
properties.description: Audits missing and false DNS proxy values on explicitly selected Firewall Policies. Unlike the upstream presence-only check, an explicit false value is noncompliant. Inheritance is not resolved.

metadata.description: Read-only evaluation.
Required, nonempty Firewall Policy resource IDs whose approved DNS architecture requires explicit DNS proxy configuration.

properties.displayName: Audit all Public IPs require approved DDoS Network Protection
properties.description: Audits public IP addresses unless DDoS protection mode is Enabled with an approved DDoS protection plan. Protection inherited from the virtual network can optionally be accepted. Read-only; it does not enable protection or associate plans.

metadata.description: Read-only evaluation.

metadata.displayName: Approved DDoS protection plan resource IDs
metadata.description: Required, nonempty list of approved DDoS Network Protection plan resource IDs. A public IP is approved only when ddosSettings.protectionMode is Enabled and ddosSettings.ddosProtectionPlan.id is in this list.

When true, public IPs whose protectionMode is VirtualNetworkInherited (or omitted) are not reported, because the plan association is on the virtual network and cannot be read from the public IP. The default false reports them.

properties.displayName: Selected Premium Firewall Policies must explicitly enable approved IDPS mode
properties.description: Audits selected Firewall Policies if the policy is not Premium or its explicit intrusionDetection.mode is missing, Off, or outside the required accepted Alert/Deny modes. Uses the real intrusionDetection.mode alias, not the malformed reference rule.

metadata.description: Read-only evaluation; the IDPS traffic mode is a separate configuration.

metadata.displayName: Approved Premium policies and IDPS modes
metadata.description: Required nonempty policy IDs and accepted IDPS modes. Accept Alert, Deny, or both according to approved inspection architecture.

properties.displayName: Web Application Firewall (WAF) policy must be enabled for Prevention mode
properties.description: Audits Application Gateway and Azure Front Door WAF policies that are disabled or not set to Prevention mode. Read-only; it does not change WAF policies. Audit by default; Deny can be selected later.

metadata.description: Audit reports WAF policies that are disabled or not in Prevention mode. Deny blocks creating or updating such a policy.
